pattern_schema.versioned_mapping_note: Cloud service mappings are maintained separately so provider service changes can be versioned without changing the vendor-neutral advisory pattern.

patterns.name: Alternate Workforce
patterns.when_to_use: Office/facility disruption where staff can work remotely or from alternate locations
patterns.when_not_to_use: Roles requiring inaccessible physical equipment or site-only operations
limitations: Dependent on identity, network, endpoint and collaboration resilience
anti_patterns: Selecting the pattern without validating business requirements and recovery evidence

patterns.name: Alternate Site / Workplace
patterns.when_to_use: Critical functions require controlled alternate facilities
patterns.when_not_to_use: Fully remote operating model is proven sufficient
anti_patterns: Selecting the pattern without validating business requirements and recovery evidence

patterns.name: Manual Workaround
patterns.when_to_use: Short disruptions can be handled through documented manual processing
patterns.when_not_to_use: Transaction volume or regulatory controls make manual operation unsafe
anti_patterns: Selecting the pattern without validating business requirements and recovery evidence

patterns.name: Crisis Management & Communications
patterns.when_not_to_use: Never; communication failure is a resilience risk
limitations: Depends on current contact trees and decision rights
anti_patterns: Selecting the pattern without validating business requirements and recovery evidence
